title: SourceResumeV2Structured
description: S1: Structured source resume input schema for apps_rg resume-shipping pipeline. Supports per-section verbatim preservation, tiered bullet treatment placeholders, and backward-compatible flat text fallback. No generation behavior is defined here — schema only.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema. Must be '2.0.0' for W1 structured format.

flat_text_fallback.description: Optional legacy flat-text resume content. Present when migrating from flat input. Structured fields take precedence when both are present.

roles.description: Work experience roles in reverse chronological order.

early_career.description: Early career roles — preserved verbatim, no LLM rewrite.

education.description: Education entries — preserved verbatim, no LLM rewrite.

certifications.description: Certification entries — preserved verbatim, no LLM rewrite.

RewritePolicy.description: Rewrite intensity policy for section content.

JudgePolicy.description: Judge panel policy for section evaluation.

HeadlineSection.description: One-line professional headline. Heavy rewrite in S3+ — schema placeholder only in S1.

preserve_verbatim.description: If true, headline must not be rewritten. Default false (heavy treatment in S3+).

treatment_tier.description: S1 placeholder. Treatment strategy set in S2. One of: HEAVY, MODERATE, LIGHT, VERBATIM, null.

ExecutiveSummarySection.description: Executive summary paragraph. Heavy rewrite in S3+ — schema placeholder only in S1.

preserve_verbatim.description: If true, summary must not be rewritten.

treatment_tier.description: S1 placeholder. Treatment strategy set in S2.

Role.description: A single work experience role with narrative and bullet entries.

section_id.description: Canonical section identifier for this role (e.g., 'unify', 'ibm', 'insurtech', 'ey', 'early_career').

narrative.description: Role narrative paragraph. Source verbatim — copied as-is unless overridden.

preserve_narrative_verbatim.description: If true, narrative must be copied verbatim with no LLM rewrite. Default true — narratives are always verbatim in S1.

source_span_refs.description: Optional references to source document spans this role is drawn from.

bullet_treatment_tier.description: S1 placeholder for S2 treatment matrix. Role-level default tier for bullets. One of: HEAVY, MODERATE, LIGHT, VERBATIM, null.

Bullet.description: A single achievement bullet within a role.

source_text.description: Verbatim source bullet text from the original resume.

source_span_ref.description: Optional reference to source document span this bullet originates from.

ordinal.description: 1-based position of this bullet within the role.

treatment_tier.description: S1 placeholder. Per-bullet treatment override. Set by S2 treatment matrix. One of: HEAVY, MODERATE, LIGHT, VERBATIM, null.

rewrite_allowed.description: If false, bullet must not be rewritten regardless of tier. Default true.

preserve_verbatim.description: If true, bullet is copied verbatim with no LLM involvement. Overrides treatment_tier.

evidence_required.description: If true, a C0/FEC evidence item must back this bullet before rewrite is permitted.

VerbatimSection.description: A section that is always preserved verbatim — no LLM rewrite. Used for education, certifications, early_career.

entries.description: Verbatim text entries for this section.

preserve_verbatim.description: Always true for verbatim sections. Schema-level assertion.

VerbatimEntry.description: A single verbatim-preserved entry (e.g. one degree, one certification, one early-career role).

preserve_verbatim.description: Always true. Redundant but explicit for downstream consumers.

CompetenciesSection.description: Core competencies list. JD-ranked in S2+, schema placeholder in S1.

items.description: Competency phrases (2-4 word noun phrases preferred).

treatment_tier.description: S1 placeholder. JD-ranking applied in S2.

preserve_verbatim.description: If true, competencies are copied verbatim without JD reranking.
